svg.title: FB1: exact sensor and force path
svg.desc: The original finger moves on four metal leaf guides. An adjustable flat plunger loads a downward-facing Honeywell FMAMSDXX025WC2C3 sensor. Its small PCB is fully supported by an insulated metal backing with an open vent.

g.text: FB1 · one force sensor at the root of each finger
Functional section, not to scale. This is a digital design; no physical force result is supplied.
11 mm active length × 12 mm width × 2.25 mm thickness
Fully supports the PCB under the FMA; Ø1.5 mm vent passage
50 µm polyimide insulation, then 1 mm FR4 PCB
PCB vent Ø0.45 mm; do not fill it with solder or adhesive
Only its 440C stainless sphere contacts the flat plunger
Ø5 mm flat contact face on adjustable M4 × 0.7 plunger
Center: native X −7.50, Y −33.77, Z 17.2675 mm, before preload
Original nail / TPU → floating carrier → plunger → FMA → backing → fixed jaw
Four clamped leaf guides react side loads and moments
Three separate stops: set 0.08 ± 0.01 mm gap after preload
The force path adds 50 mm reach at the root. No added tactile layer covers the leading nail.
Catalog sensor force includes preload. Installed finger force and contact require measured calibration.
